messages:
sarah-sales: Quick heads-up — onboarding call with NovaBank tomorrow. They need a POC to prove EU+APAC residency and 'no-US-control-plane' for sensitive models. Can we scope?
eli-solutions: Thanks — main asks I heard: 1) data ingress/egress stays in EU or APAC, 2) control plane signalling must not traverse US, 3) BYOK with HSM available in EU region, 4) pricing for dedicated reserved capacity during POC.
chris-engr: Re: control plane — current Private offering has a customer-managed control plane option (VPC peering). For hosted POC we do control-plane endpoints in eu-west and ap-northeast; however some telemetry still goes to our central plane in us-east for billing unless we enable local-only control plane. That needs eng-ops signoff.
maria-legal: Is NovaBank asking for subprocessor proximate locations too? We need to list cloud providers and any third-party monitoring vendors that touch metadata.
luis-privacy: They specifically listed: no metadata or payload to leave EU/APAC. BYOK HSM must be backed by customer key; pre-shared attestation report required.iops-bot: @channel POC checklist created: https://redwood.internal/poc/1799993333 — includes network diagram template and certs
eli-solutions: @chris-engr can you confirm if we can route telemetry to eu-west-only for the POC? If not, we should propose Dedicated with private control plane (on-prem-ish) and include egress estimates.
chris-engr: Short answer: yes for Dedicated + Private control plane. For hosted with strict residency we currently still send some usage metrics to us-east for billing. We can toggle metric forwarding in a customer-isolation patch but it is non-trivial; timeline ~2 weeks and requires infra change window.
maria-legal: Also need subprocessor list for eu-west & ap-northeast: cloud infra provider, logging (we use internal ELK hosted on-region if requested), and audit vendor (optional). I'll pull the SDD and subproc attestation.
sarah-sales: Pricing ask from procurement: how much incremental for reserved capacity in two regions for a 6-week POC? And what's the commitment flex? They prefer not to sign annual.
eli-solutions: We should show two options: (A) Short-term Dedicated burst reservation (6 weeks) — price = baseline reserved hourly * 6 weeks * 1.2 (setup overhead). (B) Hosted with geo-pin + fallback to us if capacity — cheaper but fails residency requirement.
luis-privacy: We must add a data flow diagram that shows no-key material leaving customer HSM. BYOK flow: customer uploads wrapped key to our keystore connector in eu-west/ap-northeast, unwrap happens in customer HSM during session — no unwrapped key persisted.
chris-engr: Technical note to include in reply: `routing_policy: { primary_region: eu-west-1, secondary_region: ap-northeast-1, fallback: none }` if customer requires strict residency. That disables cross-region fallback which impacts availability. Also add recommended SLA tradeoffs.
eli-solutions: I'll draft an options doc to share on the call. Action items: @maria-legal gather subproc attestation for eu & ap; @chris-engr confirm infra change ETA; @ops-bot attach POC cost calc; @luis-privacy prepare BYOK diagram.
sarah-sales: Great — planting this on the NovaBank call. If we can promise dedicated private-control-plane for the POC + BYOK attestation and provide a short-term price, this deal looks green. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Attached files: poc-network-diagram.png, poc-cost-estimate.xlsx
